notes: Variant unit v004 (s014, s015) is underdetermined; the base reading was projected and the English permits it.

The supplied 'in' before 'a separate house' was given to the noun as an adverbial accusative under rule 33, and the supplied 'a' to the same nominal expression under rule 15; the article on the rectum is unrepresented because the ASV writes no 'the' for the phrase (rule 29).
'the people of the land' is rule 29's arthrous case: nothing is fronted, the article takes the 'the' before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one.
The margin's 'infirmary' was read and set aside (rule 38).
